subject: MedSmart security exhibit — SOC 2, pen-test, and evidence cadence
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medsmart.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsmart.com; security@medsmart.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit — SOC 2 evidence & pen-test window

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement asked me to kick off the security exhibit conversation so we can finish the order form and get signoff. Two asks from Legal/Security here: 

1) Can you provide your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and the cover letter with the period covered? We need to attach it to the procurement packet.

2) We need to confirm the language and constraints for a customer-conducted penetration test and limited inspection (MSA + security exhibit). Specifically:
   - Pen-test window expectations (notice required, staging or prod, destructive testing allowed?)
   - Evidence cadence and sample sets for SOC 2 assertions (who will supply sample artifacts / timelines)

I'm attaching MedSmart_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx with the specific fields Legal wants aligned to the MSA. If you can draft suggested redlines for the security exhibit and order form, that would speed up procurement.

Goal: Have final order form and DocuSign ready by next Friday (8/6).

Appreciate it — Jordan

--
Jordan Price
Head of IT Security | MedSmart Health
jordan.price@medsmart.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medsmart.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com; soojin_lee@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — SOC 2 evidence & pen-test window

Jordan — thanks for laying this out and for the questionnaire. Attachments: I uploaded a short redline proposal (Redline_proposal_MedSmart.pdf) that contains our suggested edits to the MSA security exhibit and the Order Form. High-level answers below to unblock procurement: 

- SOC 2: We will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report covering 01/01/2026–12/31/2026 (cover letter included). We can attach that to the order form and provide a secure link for your review.

- Pen-test & limited inspection: We are generally comfortable with a timeboxed, non-destructive pen-test on a staging environment. Proposed constraints: 
   * 14 days of notice for scheduled tests (shorter for emergency bug bounty / critical findings if mutually agreed).
   * Tests limited to staging environment unless otherwise negotiated; production testing requires a separate exception and explicit SLA carveouts.
   * Tests must be non-destructive and follow our acceptance criteria (listed in the draft MSA clause).

- Evidence cadence: We propose a biweekly evidence handoff for the first month after go-live for onboarding, then monthly thereafter for running customers. If you need daily sampling during ramp, we can add a short-lived onboarding cadence.

Looping in Karthik (Legal) and Soojin (Security Ops) to confirm the redline language and add any legal constraints. Proposed next steps: Karthik to review redlines; if agreed, I can push the order form with DocuSign link and the SOC 2 bundle to procurement.

Next action: Karthik / Soojin — can you review the attached and confirm whether the pen-test language and notice windows are acceptable?

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com; Jordan Price <jordan.price@medsmart.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — SOC 2 evidence & pen-test window

Ben / Jordan / team — I reviewed Ben's draft redlines and have a few legal clarifications to propose. I've attached a short MSA clause draft (MSA_pen_test_clause_draft.pdf) and a marked-up redline. Key points: 

1) Limited inspection vs privileged inspection: Our preference is "limited inspection" with scoped access to evidence (SOC artifacts, logs) via a dedicated evidence portal or ephemeral read-only staging credentials. We should avoid granting privileged shell or admin access.

2) Notice & timeboxing: Proposed mutually-agreed notice of 10 business days for standard pen-tests and a 48–72 hour notice for low-impact evidence spot-checks. For pen-tests that require increased privileges (if ever), require a separate addendum and a 30-day review period.

3) Non-destructive and safe-guarding production: We will not permit destructive testing in production. Production may only be used for read-only verification and must be arranged with our SRE on-call in a narrow window.

4) Evidence retention & redaction: We can commit to providing specific sample artifacts for SOC 2 assertions (config snapshots, audit logs) but reserve the right to redact customer-sensitive identifiers. We should add a clause specifying how long evidence is retained for audit purposes (suggest 90 days post-delivery).

5) Liability & scope carveouts: Legal asks to cap liability for customer-conducted tests to instances where Redwood is shown to have materially contributed to an incident during the test. Also request that any findings are first reported through our security intake and are not published without a remediation window (30 days).

Jordan — can you confirm whether MedSmart requires on-site inspection rights or whether a virtual, evidence-portal driven inspection satisfies your procurement checklist? If virtual works, that simplifies the order form.

If you approve, Ben — I'll finalize the redline and we can generate a DocuSign amendment for the order form.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medsmart.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsmart.com; security@medsmart.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — SOC 2 evidence & pen-test window

Thanks — that helps a lot. A few clarifications from MedSmart: 

- Virtual inspection is acceptable; procurement prefers it if we can get the SOC 2 bundle and a secure evidence portal link. On-site is only required for legacy integrations and won't be necessary here.

- Can you confirm the SOC 2 report publish date and whether there are any caveats in the cover letter (e.g., subservice organizations)? We need the exact report date to attach to our internal approval.

- Procurement will need the final order form with the redlines baked in and a DocuSign URL. If you can share the DocuSign by EOD Monday (8/2) that keeps us on track for 8/6 signoff.

- On sampling: For onboarding we need two weeks of daily samples (for the first 10 business days) — after that, monthly handoffs are fine. Can Security Ops confirm they can support that ramp window?

We appreciate the explicit non-destructive wording and the evidence portal approach. If you can provide the SOC 2 link and DocuSign by Monday, we'll route to Legal + Procurement immediately.

Best,
Jordan
Head of IT Security | MedSmart Health
